strategy_notes: Generated 72 distinct relatable-humor candidates and selected 24 above the 75 weighted quality threshold after recent-archive similarity review, category/mechanism diversity checks, and hard semantic media gates. Analytics remain fallback-only for three videos with no retention, shares, or subscriber conversion data, so they were treated as weak directional evidence. Cache-first sourcing was used: never-used verified assets were preferred where they matched, then active verified cached assets were reused only for materially different scenarios. Every primary and backup background and music choice independently scores at least 85, and all 48 background URLs plus all 48 music URLs are batch-unique.
